method.description: Same MoonBit release JS AOT artifact, bound SQL and data. Snapshot = existing full SavedState JSON per strict IDB commit. Semantic = materialized row journal plus binary side attachments. Pages = full SQLite export, full-buffer 4096-byte comparison and binary dirty pages in the same IDB journal contract; not a lazy pager and not OS-aligned I/O. Both incremental paths compact at 128 records or 4 MiB. Point updates alternate equal-width INTEGER values; batch alternates +/-1 on 16 adjacent rows. Per-call total, preparation and IDB submission+strict-complete recorded; all 7x32 operations retained including compactions. ASCII payload lengths count submitted image/delta bytes, excluding constant generation metadata. Both layouts use two puts per commit. Native typed-result hashes checked after each workload and after replay; page files reopened by native SQLite. CPU run sequentially on one machine, no throttling. Separate fresh Chromium context/page per layout/dataset.
method.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage: used JS heap and backingStorageSize (ArrayBuffers/external strings) reported separately. Baseline before fixture load, retained after both workloads/reopen, prepared while paused just before IDB submission, and after commit. Prepared retention is not transient peak allocation, browser-process RSS or IndexedDB service memory. Current engine keeps all rows for every layout; page prototype adds a full SQLite buffer.
